payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_ledger.py::test_a_fresh_ledgers_runs_table_admits_only_the_closed_set_of_statuses stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/ledger.py. The claim was "A fresh ledger's `runs` table admits `RUNNING`, `COMPLETE`, `ABORTED` and NULL as a status, and its `CHECK` refuses any other. The witness writes through a `sqlite3` connection of its own, past every method of `Ledger`. The row `create_run` mints reads `RUNNING`. An `UPDATE` to each admitted value reads back, and an `INSERT` that names no status lands. An `UPDATE` and an `INSERT` of `ABORTD`, `complete`, `PASSED`, `FAILED`, `DRAINED` or the empty string each raise `sqlite3.IntegrityError`.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_ledger.py::test_a_run_status_outside_the_closed_set_is_refused_before_anything_is_written, tests/test_ledger_fold_task.py::test_a_run_finished_fact_outside_the_closed_set_aborts_its_fold, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
